🎉 KEBABSTAR PROLOGUE COMING IN 15 AUGUSTGet ready for a free culinary adventure! 

KEBABSTAR PROLOGUE is launching on August 15th!  

Embark on an exciting journey through the first three chapters, each bursting with unique flavors and vibrant settings. First, spice things up in Arabian Deserts, where luxury party meets with the Boran's destiny. Then, experience the modern Beach Of Dubai. Finally, immerse yourself in the rich history and bustling energy of Istanbul's Grand Bazaar, a crossroads of cultures and tastes. 

Mark your calendars! 🗓️ 

This mouthwatering prologue is just the beginning!🎮
